gsc.selection: All original compact GSC records with -3 <= magnitude <= 12; catalog object classification and completeness are not reinterpreted.
gsc.tiles: 24 RA hours x 36 five-degree declination bands; 864 files. Exact packed-record multiset preserved for each RA hour.
gsc.browser_cache_policy: LRU: at most 32 decoded tiles and 200,000 records. Only field-intersecting RA/Dec tiles are loaded; polar views do not fetch all declinations.

projection.precision: Browser Number; original Extended/x87 bit equivalence unvalidated. No gnomonic or alternative astronomy model introduced.
